name: Pentair

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Pentair Logo.jpg; JPEG 2681x680, no SVG/PNG on Wikipedia)

description: Pentair describes itself as a pure-play water company with three segments as of 2025: Pool (pumps, filters, heaters, lights and cleaners for residential and commercial pools), Water Solutions (water treatment, filtration, commercial ice machines) and Flow (pumps and fluid products for residential, agricultural, commercial and industrial users). It sells mostly through wholesale and retail distributors, and one Pool customer was about 18 percent of 2025 sales ($4.18B). Pool earns 46 percent of segment income on 37 percent of sales, at a 34 percent margin. Demand is seasonal (April to August peak) and tied to pool use, housing and replacement; sales fell 17 percent in Q2 2026 as Pool distributors destocked.

gics.note: Sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies'; industry group and industry not given there. Mowgli note: the 10-K calls it a 'pure play water industrial manufacturing company'; the largest-earning segment sells pool equipment to residential owners through distributors.

hq.note: EDGAR business address: Regal House, 70 London Road, Twickenham, London. Wikipedia's S&P 500 list shows Worsley, United Kingdom; see conflicts.

employees.note: FY2025 10-K: approximately 9,000 employees, about 49% in the US

businessLines.name: Pool
businessLines.how: Sells equipment through wholesale and retail distributors to pool builders, service companies and owners; one-time sales with early-buy programs (extended payment terms or extra discounts) before the season, plus replacement and repair demand on the installed base of pools.
businessLines.description: Residential and commercial pool equipment and accessories: pumps, filters, heaters, lights, automatic controls, chlorinators, automatic cleaners and maintenance equipment.

revenue.note: FY2024 $1,436.1M; FY2023 $1,343.6M. This segment is unchanged by the 2026 reorganization. 10-Q: Q2 2026 company sales -17.0% (volume -20.6%) primarily from Pool channel destocking.

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $1,436.1M; FY2023 $1,343.6M. This segment is unchanged by the 2026 reorganization. 10-Q: Q2 2026 company sales -17.0% (volume -20.6%) primarily from Pool channel destocking.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $476.5M. Share is of reportable segment income $1,143.1M before corporate costs; shares and margin computed.

businessLines.name: Water Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells treatment equipment, filters and ice machines through wholesale and retail distribution to businesses (food and beverage, commercial) and homeowners, with replaceable filters and cartridges recurring on the installed base; demand follows warm weather.
businessLines.description: Commercial and residential water treatment products and systems (pressure tanks, control valves, activated carbon products, filtration, commercial ice machines). About 66% commercial and 34% residential in FY2025. From January 1, 2026, the residential and irrigation flow business (pumps) moved into this segment from Flow.

revenue.note: Before the 2026 recast: FY2024 $1,684.3M; FY2023 $1,799.2M. A commercial business exit in Q2 2025 reduced sales.

businessLines.revenueNote: Before the 2026 recast: FY2024 $1,684.3M; FY2023 $1,799.2M. A commercial business exit in Q2 2025 reduced sales.

businessLines.name: Flow
businessLines.how: Sells pumps, pressure vessels, membrane filtration and valves through distributors and directly to project customers (fire suppression, water supply, wastewater, flood control, food and beverage); one-time equipment sales plus project work and aftermarket.
businessLines.description: Pumps and fluid treatment for residential and agricultural (about 36% of FY2025 Flow sales), commercial and infrastructure (about 30%) and industrial solutions (about 34%) users. Hydra-Stop (specialty insertion valves, line-stop fittings) was bought in September 2025 for $292.1M.
